0022600215.text: The Magic (2-7) enter on a four-game losing streak, 12th in the East and 4 games back in the Southeast, with a 0-4 home record and a 2-3 road mark. The Kings (1-9) are 14th in the West, 7.5 games back in the Pacific, and on a three-game skid. Orlando is missing Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain, averaging 24.5 points), Jalen Suggs (knee), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), and Noah Penda (hamstring strain), while Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles surgery) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and Domantas Sabonis is day-to-day with knee soreness and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Orlando won both 2025-26 meetings, most recently 121-117 in Orlando on March 26, 2026.
